title: Book Two · Chapter 187: An Hour at the Table
story:
On Monday evening, Mum spreads cloth across the kitchen table. Ronan stops with his sample page in his hand.

“I need the table,” he says.

“So do I.”

“The test is tomorrow.”

Mum looks at him. “My customer comes tomorrow too.”

Ronan looks at the cloth. He wants to push it to one end. There is not enough room. He keeps his hands at his sides.

“When can I use it?”

“In half an hour. Can you finish your number work in your room first?”

He can. He does not like the answer, but he takes his books to the smaller space by his bed.

Dad arrives while Ronan is working. He has food and a small packet of thread for Mum. He asks if Ronan wants to eat before the practice.

“After,” Ronan says. Then his stomach makes a sound.

Dad looks down at it. “Someone disagrees.”

Ronan comes to the kitchen. Mum clears one corner for the food. They eat a quick meal while her cloth hangs safely over the other chairs.

After dinner, she puts the measured pieces away. Ronan wipes the table dry. He lays out his practice page, a pencil, and a short question card.

Mum sits opposite him for the first ten minutes. She reads two questions. He answers one correctly. On the other, he gives the opening day but forgets the closing time.

“Anything else?” she asks.

He checks and adds the time. He writes HELP on that practice. He can still use the page to practise again.

Then Mum leaves for her evening walk with her friend. Dad washes the dishes. Ronan takes a fresh sample from his bag and reads it alone.

He imagines a visitor. He writes three questions for that visitor. He writes each answer and points to its line. Then he checks the answer card.

Two answers match. The third asks about food in the room. The page says nothing about food. He writes that he needs to ask the teacher.

When the hour ends, he puts the pencils away. He wants another hour, but the words are starting to blur.

Dad brings a cup of water.

“More work?” he asks.

“Not tonight.”

Ronan takes the cup. They stand at the green door while the air grows cooler. Mum comes back with pink cheeks and a story about her friend's new shoes.

Ronan listens, then checks his school bag once. The application rules and his ordinary books are inside. The samples stay at home. He closes the bag and gets ready for bed.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

disagree＝不同意；blur＝变模糊；closing time＝结束、关门时间；imagine＝想象。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样协调自己练习和Mum工作的时间冲突？
2. 带帮助的练习和后来的独立练习分别怎样进行？

## 读句子

**He keeps his hands at his sides.**

拆开看：He / keeps / his hands at his sides.

他／让双手保持／在身体两侧。
